page.layout: Top right: running head "Fol. i" (folio number). Full-width title block: ornamental woodcut band, then centred title lines in large type. Below: one text column with a large initial "A", with two marginal note columns at the right edge (notes in the right margin, small italic). Signature "A" at the foot of the column, catchword "lu-" at the right.

main_text.l: I. ATque hactenus Ecclesiæ infantiam & adolescentiam,
tardosque ejus auctus & incrementa vidimus, utque illa
diu circa matrem suam luctata, ac Cananæae finibus
conclusa fuerit; in quâ, difficili ministerio exercita, terrenæ
istius hæreditatis pignus tractare, & templi umbris ac figuris
sese oblectare, ac veluti per cancellos ejus, Salvatorem suum de lon-
ginquo tantum prospicere necesse habuit. Nunc vero clarior & il-lu-

marginalia.note: Fœdus gratiæ sub V. T. excipit ejus oeconomia sub N. T.

page.notes: The title block is an engraved ornamental band above the title; the "Fol. i" at top right is a folio number. Right-margin notes are small italic and partly cut; the note text is reconstructed as best readable. Digitiser's "Digitized by Google" stamp at lower right omitted. Initial "A" is a large woodcut letter joined to "Atque". Catchword "lu-" is the hyphenated word continued on the next page.
